scope: Explicit review of the initial 26 unresolved outdoor anchors. Corrections stay in the same landblock, within 20m, connected by native floor samples every 25cm; final full body, dry ground and population separation are verified. Only static props proven to contain the original point may be omitted from the authoring escape route; all props remain in the destination clearance and the game world. This is a documented repair, not recovered retail spawn coordinates. The four remaining 4DA2 anchors are verified unchanged using native CSetup spheres and 100 physics quanta with walkable contact, zero displacement, and no SLIDE_SPF/FORCE_SPF. Open-air, buried and missing-platform controls fail. No actor-specific collision exemption or scale change.
